build_chinese_clip_model: build a ChineseCLIP model with vision and text backbone configs for zero-shot classification
predict_image_classes: predict image class labels using ChineseCLIP zero-shot classification with text prototypes
extract_image_features: extract image latent features from a batch of images using the vision backbone
extract_text_features: extract text latent features from tokenized Chinese text using the text backbone
compute_image_text_similarity: compute cosine similarity between image and text feature embeddings for retrieval
